Sofia (eng-sre): Quick closure thread for Ember postmortem actions — owners + very short targets. I will track daily until everything is closed.

Sofia (eng-sre): Actions (short):
- Arun: implement ordered route write + 12s reconcile delay (owner) — target: Thu EOD
- Mei: peer-health probe + route-staleness alert (owner) — target: next sprint kickoff
- Claire: provision ephemeral mirror tenant + customer sync note (owner) — target: Wed 14:00 PT

Arun (eng-platform): Taking the route write. Initial plan: write routes with version tags and delay re-advertise for 12s after withdraw. Will open PR and link tests.

Mei (infra): Probe plan: 90s cadence, alert on 3 fails, metric for withdraw/announce churn. Start pager-only; escalate to auto-failover if correlated churn >15m.

Claire (prodops): Mirror tenant provisioned: ember-mirror-48h. Drafted customer note and scheduled Ember sync Wed 14:00 PT.

Sofia (eng-sre): Snippet from outage log to keep context:
```
[2024-09-03T09:12:11Z] BGP: withdraw 10.50.2.0/24 -> ember-edge
[2024-09-03T09:12:12Z] Routing: reconcile detected stale-tag
[2024-09-03T09:12:14Z] Service: connection resets, KV cache misses spike
```
ops-bot: Created issue #7033 "ember-onprem-peering-reconcile-fix" and linked to postmortem. Assignee: Arun. Due: 2024-09-12.

Arun (eng-platform): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1198 (WIP). Adding Mei and Sofia as reviewers.

Mei (infra): Probe deployed to staging. Will run a 2-hour spike tomorrow to validate false-positive rate.

Sofia (eng-sre): Daily close: Arun PR -> WIP; Mei probe -> staging; Claire comms -> scheduled. Please post one-line updates here when you make progress so I can update the tracker. Thanks! :raised_hands:
